basis: M10W27 outcome-blind causal information availability audit only. No low-ATR future return, PF, PnL, win/loss label, outcome correlation or profit-ranked feature was used. To avoid selecting only the high-ATR historical winner after observing M10W25C, all three exact M10W23 semantic formulas are carried forward together without change.
target_regime: D1 EMA20>EMA30>EMA40 AND H4 EMA20>EMA30 AND H1 TORYS MACD line(6,13,4)>0 AND H1 Wilder ATR14 percentile100<0.33 AND prefix-causal coverage_class=NEITHER

common.decision_grid: M15 decision timestamps from M10W27 causal NEITHER rows
common.entry: Exact M1 execution at decision timestamp; ask=M1 open + spread_points*point
common.exit: Exact M1 timestamp +240 minutes; bid=M1 open

LMVI1_LONG_M5_VOLUME_IMPULSE.threshold_origin: semantic/no-outcome: activity at or above trailing-20 mean, body at least half of range, close in upper third

LMWR1_LONG_M5_PULLBACK_REJECTION.threshold_origin: semantic/no-outcome: non-positive prior 15-minute move, lower wick at least 40% of bar, close in upper 40%

LMMO1_LONG_M1_MICRO_MOMENTUM.threshold_origin: semantic/no-outcome: positive five-minute return, majority of five M1 bars up, latest closed M1 closes in upper 40%

outcome_blind_density_check.note: Counts were checked only for usable density. No low-ATR outcomes were inspected.

decision_tiers.REJECT: Any split PF <=1.0 with adequate count, or all-sample fixed0p20 PF <=1.0, or all-sample extra2bps PF <=1.0.

frozen_evaluation.fresh_shadow_rule: Only ROBUST_CANDIDATE or STRONG_CANDIDATE may advance to a new independent fresh prospective shadow. Historical support alone is not final support.

forbidden_after_results: select only the high-ATR winner retroactively
